tasks.label: Ubuntu: prepare vcan0 and build
tasks.command: if ip link show vcan0 >/dev/null 2>&1; then ip link set vcan0 up 2>/dev/null || true; else sudo modprobe vcan && sudo ip link add dev vcan0 type vcan && sudo ip link set vcan0 up; fi && cmake -S . -B build-ubuntu -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DRAUCH_FETCH_CAN_UTILS=ON && cmake --build build-ubuntu --parallel

tasks.label: Windows: build
tasks.command: cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DRAUCH_FETCH_CAN_UTILS=OFF -DRAUCH_ENABLE_PCAN=ON -DPCAN_BASIC_ROOT="C:/Program Files/PEAK-System/PCAN-Basic" && cmake --build build --config Debug --parallel

tasks.label: Ubuntu: add RAUCH IP alias
tasks.command: IFACE=${RAUCH_NET_IFACE:-eth0}; ip -4 addr show dev "$IFACE" | grep -q "152.21.0.31/" || sudo ip addr add 152.21.0.31/32 dev "$IFACE"

tasks.label: Ubuntu: remove RAUCH IP alias
tasks.command: IFACE=${RAUCH_NET_IFACE:-eth0}; ip -4 addr show dev "$IFACE" | grep -q "152.21.0.31/" && sudo ip addr del 152.21.0.31/32 dev "$IFACE" || true
